about: Notes per common Nice class. Search classes are broad (coordinated classes); a filing class needs dated evidence of a bona fide intent per identification (M.Z. Berger & Co. v. Swatch AG, 787 F.3d 1368 (Fed. Cir. 2015)).

notes.label: Downloadable software, apps, electronic publications
notes.why: The class for software a customer downloads or installs; searched with 042 because the same product is often offered both ways.

notes.label: Advertising, business management, office functions
notes.why: Search it when the mark will be used for a marketplace, a directory or business services around the product; not a filing class for software itself.

notes.label: Telecommunications, online forums, chat
notes.why: Search it for messaging or communication features; file in it only with evidence of a telecommunications service.

notes.label: Education, training, publishing (non-downloadable)
notes.why: Search it for courses, webinars or online publications offered under the mark.

notes.label: Software as a service, platforms, technology services
notes.why: The class for hosted software (SaaS, PaaS); the usual filing class for a web application.

notes.label: Legal services
notes.why: A filing class only with evidence of intent to provide legal services; software for lawyers is 009/042, not 045. Searched because legal-services marks are related to legal software.
